title: DNA Extraction from Ball Python Sheds
author: Jose Avila Cervantes
materials: EQUIPMENT Dry Bath / Heated Block Microcentrifuge DNA LoBind tubes 1.5mL Micropipettes Assorted pipette tips

REAGENTS Lysis Buffer ( 10 millimolar (mM) Tris-base, 100 millimolar (mM) EDTA, 2% SDS, 5 Molarity (M) , NaCl, pH 8 ) TE Buffer (EDTA 1 millimolar (mM) , Tris-Cl 10 millimolar (mM) ) Proteinase K ( 20 mg/mL ) Phenol/Chloroform/Isoamyl Alcohol 25:24:1 (v/v) Ethanol 100 % Ethanol 70 % (Freshly prepared) Tris Acetate-EDTA (TAE) Buffer SYBR Safe DNA stain Agarose Loading Dye Wide Range Ladder (100-12,000 bp)
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Cut a 3–5 mm piece of fresh tissue, place it in a 1.5 mL microtube, add 900 µL lysis buffer, add 9 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL), vortex for 30 seconds, then incubate at 55 °C overnight.

substeps.instruction: Cut a small piece of fresh tissue (3‑5 mm).
Put the tissue in a 1.5 mL microtube.
Add 900 µL lysis buffer.
Add 9 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL).
Vortex thoroughly for 30 seconds.
Incubate at 55 °C overnight.

steps.title: Phenol‑Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Phenol/Chloroform/Isoamyl Alcohol (25:24:1 v/v), vortex 30 seconds, centrifuge at room temperature for 5 minutes at 16,000 × g, then carefully transfer the ~500 µL upper aqueous phase to a fresh tube without carrying over phenol.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL Phenol/Chloroform/Isoamyl Alcohol (25:24:1 v/v).
Vortex thoroughly for 30 seconds.
Centrifuge at room temperature for 5 minutes at 16,000 × g.
Carefully remove the upper aqueous phase (~500 µL) and transfer it to a fresh tube, avoiding phenol carry‑over.

steps.title: Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1000 µL 100 % ethanol, invert the tube and freeze at –80 °C for 1 hour (or at –20 °C overnight); centrifuge at 4 °C for 30 minutes at 16,000 × g, discard supernatant, wash pellet with 150 µL 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at 4 °C for 5 minutes at 16,000 × g, discard supernatant, repeat the 70 % ethanol wash once and remove residual ethanol, air‑dry DNA at room temperature for 5–10 minutes, then resuspend the pellet in 200 µL TE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1000 µL of 100 % ethanol, invert the tube.
Place the tube at –80 °C for 1 hour or at –20 °C overnight.
Centrifuge the sample at 4 °C for 30 minutes at 16,000 × g to pellet the DNA.
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Add 150 µL of 70 % ethanol.
Centrifuge the sample at 4 °C for 5 minutes at 16,000 × g.
Carefully remove the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Repeat the 70 % ethanol wash once and remove as much remaining ethanol as possible.
Dry the DNA at room temperature for 5–10 minutes.
Resuspend the DNA pellet in 200 µL TE buffer.

steps.title: DNA Quality Check
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 % agarose gel in 1× TAE with 1× SYBR Safe, load 4 µL Wide Range Ladder (100–12,000 bp) in the first well, premix each sample with loading dye (9 µL sample + 1 µL 10× dye or 5 µL sample + 1 µL 6× dye) and load, run the gel 40 minutes at 100 V, then visualize on a trans‑illuminator and photograph.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 1 % agarose gel with 1× TAE buffer and 1× SYBR Safe DNA stain.
Add 4 µL Wide Range Ladder (100‑12,000 bp) in the first well.
Premix 9 µL of sample with 1 µL of 10× loading dye (or 5 µL sample with 1 µL of 6× loading dye) and load this mixture in each well.
Run the samples for 40 minutes at 100 V.
Visualize in a trans‑illuminator and take a photo of the gel.
